title: EC Cruel Kingdom #3
desc: GOT AN AXE TO GRIND? So do your favorite wizards, warlocks, and backstabbing knights as EC Comics journeys back to ye olde days of yore to cast its dark thrall!Love a good bard's tale of brave heroes and boastful villains? Too bad: They don't stand a chance against EC's bone-breaking tales of fatal fantasy and magical malice, as orchestrated from the palace shadows by ruthless writers Cameron Chittock (TMNT/Stranger Things), Jude Ellison S. Doyle (Dead Teenagers), and Ryan Haddock (Catacomb of Torment) and wrought into bloody reality by agonizing artists Ramón F. Bachs (Monsters Unleashed), Riccardo Burchielli (DMZ), and Ryan Kelly (Saucer Country)!
